headline: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton condemns ad featuring her estranged mother
standfirst: Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother.
body_markdown:
Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother. NBC News national politics reporter Henry Gomez discusses how close the race between Acton and Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has become in the campaign's final two weeks. (NBC News)

**Axios** adds: Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign for Ohio governor is pouring $4 million into a bombshell ad in which his opponent's estranged mother attacks her daughter — doubling down on the message despite fierce bipartisan backlash, Axios has learned. Why it matters: Ramaswamy is gambling that the deeply personal attack by Amy Acton's mother — who Acton has said sided with her stepfather after he sexually assaulted Acton when she was 12 — will resonate with voters.

**CBS News** adds: Ohio candidate for governor Vivek Ramaswamy is facing strong criticism for releasing an attack ad featuring his opponent Amy Acton's estranged mother. CBS News political director Fin Gómez has more.

**ABC News** adds: Ohio Gubernatorial Candidate Amy Acton’s campaign alleged her opponent's campaign is using her estranged mother in a controversial political ad against her.

**South China Morning Post** adds: Vivek Ramaswamy, the Republican candidate for Ohio governor, faced a firestorm of criticism Wednesday over an ad featuring Democratic rival Amy Acton’s estranged mother, whose husband was charged with raping Acton when she was a child. Acton has not spoken with her mother, Donna Arthur, since her childhood, when she accused her then-stepfather of sexually abusing her for years.

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by ABC News, CBS News, South China Morning Post, Axios and NBC News. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
